part:chassis.title: Chassis tub
part:chassis.desc: One molded tub: floor, motor saddles, battery cradle, mast guide tower, servo ribs, treat chute, anti-tip skid, sensor windows.

part:light_band.title: Light band
part:light_band.desc: Frosted clear-PC ring on the split line. Glows with the LED ring: mood, status, night-light.

part:top_shell.title: Top shell
part:top_shell.desc: Upper body with the head nest, the privacy brow, the treat-cup pocket and the speaker grille all molded in.
part:top_shell.process: Injection molded (1 slider for the grille)

part:treat_cup.title: Treat cup
part:treat_cup.desc: Lift-out, dishwasher-safe PP cup, ~180 ml (~120 small kibble treats). Funnel floor feeds the rotor.

part:cup_lid.title: Cup lid
part:cup_lid.desc: Smoke-tint lid that is the top of the body when closed. Snap fit, finger tab underneath.

part:rotor.title: Treat rotor
part:rotor.desc: Two-pocket acetal rotor: each half-turn of the servo drops one treat down the chute and out of the chin.

part:mast.title: Periscope mast
part:mast.desc: Hollow POM mast with the rack molded in. Lifts the head 85 mm: asleep, roam, or meerkat "sentinel" stance.
part:mast.material: POM or PA12-GF, rack molded in

part:head_rear.title: Head shell
part:head_rear.desc: Rounded head with two little ears (mic ports) and the mast socket.

part:head_front.title: Face plate
part:head_front.desc: Gloss espresso face: eye window with bezel and the camera "nose".

part:wheel_l.title: Wheel hub
part:wheel_l.desc: 68 mm wheel, paw-print hubcap; 2-shot molded with its TPU tyre (one part). Climbs rug edges and 12 mm thresholds.

part:tire_l.title: Tyre (TPU overmold)
part:tire_l.desc: Soft 85A TPU tread with sipes: quiet on hard floors, grips on rugs.

part:wheel_r.title: Wheel hub
part:wheel_r.desc: 68 mm wheel, paw-print hubcap; 2-shot molded with its TPU tyre (one part). Climbs rug edges and 12 mm thresholds.

part:tire_r.title: Tyre (TPU overmold)
part:tire_r.desc: Soft 85A TPU tread with sipes: quiet on hard floors, grips on rugs.

part:dock.title: Dock
part:dock.desc: Weighted charging dock: spring contacts, IR beacon, USB-C in. Meerlo backs onto it by itself.

elec:motor_l_gearbox.title: Drive gearmotor N20 + encoder
elec:motor_l_gearbox.desc: N20 metal gearmotor, 6 V, 1:50, 2-channel magnetic encoder (wheel odometry). ~300 rpm at 3.7 V gives 0.5 m/s top speed on 68 mm wheels; 2 per robot.

elec:motor_l_can.title: Drive gearmotor N20 + encoder
elec:motor_l_can.desc: N20 metal gearmotor, 6 V, 1:50, 2-channel magnetic encoder (wheel odometry). ~300 rpm at 3.7 V gives 0.5 m/s top speed on 68 mm wheels; 2 per robot.

elec:motor_l_shaft.title: Drive gearmotor N20 + encoder
elec:motor_l_shaft.desc: N20 metal gearmotor, 6 V, 1:50, 2-channel magnetic encoder (wheel odometry). ~300 rpm at 3.7 V gives 0.5 m/s top speed on 68 mm wheels; 2 per robot.

elec:motor_l_encoder.title: Drive gearmotor N20 + encoder
elec:motor_l_encoder.desc: N20 metal gearmotor, 6 V, 1:50, 2-channel magnetic encoder (wheel odometry). ~300 rpm at 3.7 V gives 0.5 m/s top speed on 68 mm wheels; 2 per robot.

elec:motor_r_gearbox.title: Drive gearmotor N20 + encoder
elec:motor_r_gearbox.desc: N20 metal gearmotor, 6 V, 1:50, 2-channel magnetic encoder (wheel odometry). ~300 rpm at 3.7 V gives 0.5 m/s top speed on 68 mm wheels; 2 per robot.

elec:motor_r_can.title: Drive gearmotor N20 + encoder
elec:motor_r_can.desc: N20 metal gearmotor, 6 V, 1:50, 2-channel magnetic encoder (wheel odometry). ~300 rpm at 3.7 V gives 0.5 m/s top speed on 68 mm wheels; 2 per robot.

elec:motor_r_shaft.title: Drive gearmotor N20 + encoder
elec:motor_r_shaft.desc: N20 metal gearmotor, 6 V, 1:50, 2-channel magnetic encoder (wheel odometry). ~300 rpm at 3.7 V gives 0.5 m/s top speed on 68 mm wheels; 2 per robot.

elec:motor_r_encoder.title: Drive gearmotor N20 + encoder
elec:motor_r_encoder.desc: N20 metal gearmotor, 6 V, 1:50, 2-channel magnetic encoder (wheel odometry). ~300 rpm at 3.7 V gives 0.5 m/s top speed on 68 mm wheels; 2 per robot.

elec:liftmotor_gearbox.title: Periscope lift motor N20
elec:liftmotor_gearbox.desc: N20 gearmotor 1:150 (no encoder). Drives a 12-tooth pinion on the mast rack: 80 mm of stroke in ~1.5 s. Position from motor-current end-stop homing + time.

elec:liftmotor_can.title: Periscope lift motor N20
elec:liftmotor_can.desc: N20 gearmotor 1:150 (no encoder). Drives a 12-tooth pinion on the mast rack: 80 mm of stroke in ~1.5 s. Position from motor-current end-stop homing + time.

elec:liftmotor_shaft.title: Periscope lift motor N20
elec:liftmotor_shaft.desc: N20 gearmotor 1:150 (no encoder). Drives a 12-tooth pinion on the mast rack: 80 mm of stroke in ~1.5 s. Position from motor-current end-stop homing + time.

elec:pinion.title: Mast pinion (POM, m1 z12)
elec:pinion.desc: Stock 12-tooth module-1 POM pinion pressed on the lift motor D-shaft.

elec:servo.title: Treat servo (SG90-class)
elec:servo.desc: 9 g micro servo, 180 deg. Swings the two-pocket rotor: each half turn drops exactly one treat into the chute.

elec:battery.title: 18650 Li-ion cell 3000 mAh
elec:battery.desc: One protected 18650 cell (3.6 V, ~10.8 Wh), UL 2054 / UN38.3. ~3 h roaming or 24 h+ on watch, docked.

elec:bclip_l.title: Battery contacts
elec:bclip_l.desc: Nickel-plated spring contacts pressed into the chassis cradle.

elec:bclip_r.title: Battery contacts
elec:bclip_r.desc: Nickel-plated spring contacts pressed into the chassis cradle.

elec:pcb.title: Main board (4-layer, 70x40 mm)
elec:pcb.desc: Single PCB: ESP32-S3 module, 2x DRV8833 motor drivers, 6-axis IMU, Li-ion charger + protection, I2S amp, LED driver, all connectors. Assembled on the same SMT line as the rest.

elec:esp32.title: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 N8R8
elec:esp32.desc: Dual-core 240 MHz + vector AI instructions, 8 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM, Wi-Fi 4 + BLE 5, FCC/CE-certified module. Runs navigation, on-device pet/person/sound detection and the camera stream.

elec:ic0.title: DRV8833 motor driver (x2)
elec:ic0.desc: TI DRV8833, dual H-bridge, 1.5 A/ch: one for the wheels, one for the lift motor + spare.

elec:ic1.title: DRV8833 motor driver (x2)
elec:ic1.desc: TI DRV8833, dual H-bridge, 1.5 A/ch: one for the wheels, one for the lift motor + spare.

elec:ic2.title: IMU (6-axis)
elec:ic2.desc: QMI8658 / ICM-42670-class accel + gyro: tilt, bump, pick-up and stuck detection.

elec:ic3.title: Li-ion charger + protector
elec:ic3.desc: 1.5 A linear charger + DW01 protector + NTC: charges from the dock pads in ~2.5 h.

elec:ic4.title: MAX98357A I2S amp
elec:ic4.desc: 3 W class-D I2S amplifier for voice, chirps and your recorded "good boy".

elec:tof.title: Front ToF ranger VL53L1X
elec:tof.desc: ST VL53L1X time-of-flight, 4 m, 27 deg FoV, multi-zone ROI scan: obstacle + wall following behind an IR window.

elec:cliff_fl.title: Cliff sensor ITR8307 (x3)
elec:cliff_fl.desc: Reflective IR pair looking at the floor: stops before stairs and table edges.

elec:cliff_fr.title: Cliff sensor ITR8307 (x3)
elec:cliff_fr.desc: Reflective IR pair looking at the floor: stops before stairs and table edges.

elec:cliff_rr.title: Cliff sensor ITR8307 (x3)
elec:cliff_rr.desc: Reflective IR pair looking at the floor: stops before stairs and table edges.

elec:irrx.title: Dock-homing IR receiver
elec:irrx.desc: 38 kHz IR receiver at the rear: finds the dock beacon and backs straight onto the charging pads.

elec:camera.title: Camera OV3660 (3 MP, 120 deg)
elec:camera.desc: Wide-angle 3 MP camera on a 24-pin FPC that runs down the hollow mast. Night mode with the IR-cut-free lens + 2 IR LEDs. Hidden behind the brow when Meerlo is asleep: a real privacy shutter.

elec:fpc.title: Camera/eye flex cable
elec:fpc.desc: 24-pin camera FPC + eye cable, routed down the mast channel with a 90 mm rolling service loop.

elec:mic_l.title: MEMS microphones (x2, in the ears)
elec:mic_l.desc: Two I2S MEMS mics: bark/meow/glass-break/smoke-alarm detection, direction of sound, two-way talk.

elec:mic_r.title: MEMS microphones (x2, in the ears)
elec:mic_r.desc: Two I2S MEMS mics: bark/meow/glass-break/smoke-alarm detection, direction of sound, two-way talk.

elec:irled_l.title: Night-vision IR LEDs (x2)
elec:irled_l.desc: 850 nm IR LEDs either side of the camera for seeing in the dark.

elec:irled_r.title: Night-vision IR LEDs (x2)
elec:irled_r.desc: 850 nm IR LEDs either side of the camera for seeing in the dark.

elec:lcd.title: Round eye display 1.28" GC9A01
elec:lcd.desc: 240x240 round IPS (32.4 mm active), SPI. One big expressive eye: sleepy, curious, alert, happy.

elec:speaker.title: Speaker 20x30 mm, 1 W
elec:speaker.desc: 8 ohm 1 W oval speaker firing through the rear grille.

elec:led0.title: RGB LEDs WS2812B-2020 (x12)
elec:led0.desc: 12 addressable RGB LEDs on a flex ring behind the frosted band: mood, status, night-light, "follow me" glow.

elec:caster.title: Ball caster 1/2"
elec:caster.desc: Ball caster with a 12.7 mm steel ball. 3-point stance: two wheels + this ball, plus a rear anti-tip skid.

elec:pad_l.title: Charging pads (robot side)
elec:pad_l.desc: Two gold-plated contact pads at the rear; the dock springs press on them.

elec:pad_r.title: Charging pads (robot side)
elec:pad_r.desc: Two gold-plated contact pads at the rear; the dock springs press on them.

elec:axle_l.title: Wheel fasteners
elec:axle_l.desc: M2.5 screw + washer holding each wheel on the D-shaft.

elec:axle_r.title: Wheel fasteners
elec:axle_r.desc: M2.5 screw + washer holding each wheel on the D-shaft.

elec:dock_pcb.title: Dock board + USB-C
elec:dock_pcb.desc: Tiny dock PCB: USB-C 5 V in, reverse/short protection, 38 kHz beacon driver.

elec:dock_spring_l.title: Dock spring contacts
elec:dock_spring_l.desc: Gold-plated leaf springs with 4 mm of travel: tolerant of a few mm docking error.

elec:dock_spring_r.title: Dock spring contacts
elec:dock_spring_r.desc: Gold-plated leaf springs with 4 mm of travel: tolerant of a few mm docking error.

elec:beacon.title: IR beacon LEDs
elec:beacon.desc: Two 940 nm LEDs behind the window broadcast the dock code the robot homes on.
